description: This file defines an abstract base class for setting up and managing an in-process Orleans test cluster, including configuration, lifecycle management, and precondition checks.

classes.name: BaseInProcessTestClusterFixture
classes.description: An abstract base class providing setup, configuration, lifecycle management, and precondition checks for an Orleans in-process test cluster.

methods.name: EnsurePreconditionsMet
methods.description: Ensures that preconditions for test cluster are met, throwing captured exceptions if any.

methods.name: CheckPreconditionsOrThrow
methods.description: Virtual method intended to be overridden for precondition validation before starting the cluster.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Virtual method intended to be overridden to configure the test cluster builder.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes and deploys the test cluster, and sets up logger.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the test cluster, stopping all silos and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: GetClientServiceId
methods.description: Retrieves the service ID from the cluster client's configuration.
